# LaunchLayer

LaunchLayer is a Bash launch orchestrator for Steam games. It composes profiles, per-game settings, compatibility tools, performance options, and launch hooks while keeping dry-run and inspection paths available.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/launch-layer/
- Architecture: https://bolens.github.io/launch-layer/architecture.html

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/launch-layer
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/launch-layer/issues
